+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# bin/.npm-deps — install/sync npm packages to a shared, hash-keyed location.
+#
+# Installs once per unique package-lock.json and symlinks node_modules back
+# into the worktree.  Multiple worktrees with the same lockfile share a single
+# installation; worktrees at different lockfile versions get independent
+# directories and never clobber each other.
+#
+# Called by bin/setup and by git hooks (post-merge, post-checkout).
+
+ROOT=$(dirname "$(dirname "$(realpath "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")")")
+
+_NPM_LOCK_HASH=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/package-lock.json" | cut -c1-16)
+_NPM_SHARED="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/udb/npm-$_NPM_LOCK_HASH"
+
+_NPM_MARKER="$_NPM_SHARED/.npm-install-complete"
+
+if [[ ! -f "$_NPM_MARKER" ]]; then
+  echo "npm: installing packages (npm-$_NPM_LOCK_HASH)..."
+  # Run npm ci from the repo root so it sees package.json, package-lock.json,
+  # and workspaces correctly, then relocate the result to the shared path.
+  rm -rf "$ROOT/node_modules" "$_NPM_SHARED"
+  WD=$(pwd)
+  cd "$ROOT" || exit 1
+  if ! "$ROOT/bin/npm" ci; then
+    echo "ERROR: npm ci failed." >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+  mkdir -p "$_NPM_SHARED"
+  mv "$ROOT/node_modules" "$_NPM_SHARED/node_modules"
+  touch "$_NPM_MARKER"
+  cd "$WD" || exit 1
+  echo "npm: packages installed"
+else
+  echo "npm: packages up to date (npm-$_NPM_LOCK_HASH)"
+fi
+
+# Point this worktree's node_modules at the shared installation.
+_NPM_LINK_TARGET="$_NPM_SHARED/node_modules"
+_NPM_LINK="$ROOT/node_modules"
+if [[ "$(readlink "$_NPM_LINK" 2>/dev/null)" != "$_NPM_LINK_TARGET" ]]; then
+  rm -rf "$_NPM_LINK"
+  ln -s "$_NPM_LINK_TARGET" "$_NPM_LINK"
+fi

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# bin/.venv-deps — install/sync Python packages to a shared, hash-keyed location.
+#
+# Uses UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT to direct uv sync to a shared venv outside the
+# worktree, keyed by uv.lock hash.  Multiple worktrees with the same lockfile
+# share a single venv; worktrees at different lockfile versions get independent
+# environments and never clobber each other.
+#
+# Called by bin/setup and by git hooks (post-merge, post-checkout).
+
+ROOT=$(dirname "$(dirname "$(realpath "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")")")
+
+_VENV_LOCK_HASH=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/uv.lock" | cut -c1-16)
+_VENV_SHARED="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/udb/venv-$_VENV_LOCK_HASH"
+
+_VENV_MARKER="$_VENV_SHARED/.uv-sync-complete"
+
+if [[ ! -f "$_VENV_MARKER" ]]; then
+  echo "uv: syncing packages (venv-$_VENV_LOCK_HASH)..."
+  WD=$(pwd)
+  cd "$ROOT" || exit 1
+  rm -rf "$_VENV_SHARED"
+  if ! UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$_VENV_SHARED" "$ROOT/bin/uv" sync; then
+    echo "ERROR: uv sync failed." >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+  touch "$_VENV_MARKER"
+  echo "uv: packages installed"
+  cd "$WD" || exit 1
+else
+  echo "uv: packages up to date (venv-$_VENV_LOCK_HASH)"
+fi
+
+# Point this worktree's .venv at the shared installation.
+_VENV_LINK="$ROOT/.venv"
+if [[ "$(readlink "$_VENV_LINK" 2>/dev/null)" != "$_VENV_SHARED" ]]; then
+  rm -rf "$_VENV_LINK"
+  ln -s "$_VENV_SHARED" "$_VENV_LINK"
+fi

+          debug() {
+            :
+          }
+        fi
+
+        if [ "${MISE_QUIET-}" = "1" ] || [ "${MISE_QUIET-}" = "true" ]; then
+          info() {
+            :
+          }
+        else
+          info() {
+            echo "$@" >&2
+          }
+        fi
+
+        error() {
+          echo "$@" >&2
+          exit 1
+        }

+

+        get_os() {
+          os="$(uname -s)"
+          if [ "$os" = Darwin ]; then

+            error "unsupported OS: $os"

+
+        get_arch() {
+          musl=""
+          if type ldd >/dev/null 2>/dev/null; then
+            if [ "${MISE_INSTALL_MUSL-}" = "1" ] || [ "${MISE_INSTALL_MUSL-}" = "true" ]; then
+              musl="-musl"
+            elif [ "$(uname -o)" = "Android" ]; then
+              # Android (Termux) always uses musl
+              musl="-musl"
+            else
+              libc=$(ldd /bin/ls | grep 'musl' | head -1 | cut -d ' ' -f1)
+              if [ -n "$libc" ]; then
+                musl="-musl"
+              fi
+            fi
+          fi
+          arch="$(uname -m)"
+          if [ "$arch" = x86_64 ]; then
+            echo "x64$musl"
+          elif [ "$arch" = aarch64 ] || [ "$arch" = arm64 ]; then
+            echo "arm64$musl"
+          elif [ "$arch" = armv7l ]; then
+            echo "armv7$musl"

+          else

+          fi

+          else
+            false
+          fi
+        }
